originalCondition: From a selected historical node, use an official fork surface to obtain a new native session with the complete context up to that node; keep the original and state settings/file effects. Current-context copying, a UI entry, or a single-message draft is not this result.

codex.translation: Official item ID -> containing native turn ID -> thread/fork lastTurnId. This is a turn-level selector, not an exact inner-turn message cutoff; actual context behavior was not executed.
codex.noPointBehavior: Absent/unrecognized fork object or version yields no lastTurnId: latest/current-context fork.
codex.validButMissingPoint: A parsed nonempty message ID with no resolved containing turn and no successful optional fingerprint resolution raises invalidParams before threadFork.
codex.knownVersionInvalidPoint: Version1 empty/missing/non-string messageId raises invalidParams; a valid nonempty ID with no resolved turn/fingerprint match also raises invalidParams before threadFork.

claude.translation: Live official mapping, SDK active history or full official entries resolve ACP message ID to native UUID, then SDK forkSession(upToMessageId). The observed SDK declaration says inclusive. The inspected helper does not call query; no SDK/adapter runtime or process behavior was executed.
claude.noPointBehavior: Unsupported version or empty/missing messageId yields no point and takes latest/full fork. Other malformed types are not generalized as this fallback.
claude.validButMissingPoint: Point not resolved to UUID raises invalidParams before SDK fork.

decisions.reason: Standard fork:{} and opaque messageId metadata do not establish adoption of a requested historical point. Inspected implementations contain latest fallback paths for unsupported/missing extension metadata. Inspected success objects do not provide an authoritative selected-point echo; this is a missing usable observation, not a new protocol/acceptance requirement.
decisions.currentFarfold: Only forkCurrentContext is exposed and no point is sent. Current clientInfo is farfold; its existing AIR metadata declares sessionFailure/asyncTasks, which is not a historical-point capability.
unsafeActionsRejected: Do not enable arbitrary registered agents from fork:true plus messageId alone.
Do not probe with an invalid point; an old adapter could create a genuine latest fork.
Do not pin versions or validate Agent binary SHA as a new generic compatibility rule.
Do not use local ThreadItem.id in place of optional official messageId.
Do not silently fall back to current-context copy when a requested historical point is unsupported.
